title: Todd Monken praises 'awesome' Deshaun Watson, gives update on Browns QB battle

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Todd Monken praises 'awesome' Deshaun Watson, gives update on Browns QB battle
sources.description: Todd Monken provided an update on the Browns' QB competition after their preseason loss to the Bears, praising both Deshaun Watson and Shedeur Sanders.
